messages:
Lena Park: Hey folks, quick onboarding question. Im starting Tue and my ThinkPad T490 (personal) is what Id like to use for the first week. Runs Ubuntu 22.04, TPM present but not sure if enabled in BIOS. Can we enroll this as BYOD? What exact checks do you need (secure boot, TPM2, LUKS with TPM sealing)? Also: the phishing simulation is scheduled Wed  will missing it because I'm still getting enrolled cause me to lose access? Lastly, are contractors treated differently for cert issuance?

Mara (People Ops): Welcome Lena :wave: We can do a temporary BYOD approval for the first week. High level: yes to TPM2+secure-boot when available, otherwise we'll accept LUKS full-disk with the agent escrow. Contractors: same baseline controls but we issue shorter access windows. @IT-helpdesk will list the pre-checks.

IT-helpdesk: Hey Lena  we can enroll your T490. Checklist we need before push: 1) confirm secure boot enabled or TPM accessible (`ls /dev/tpm*`), 2) output of `sudo cryptsetup status <luks-device>` (or `lsblk -f`), 3) OS up-to-date, 4) disk encrypted with LUKS (prefer LUKS2). If you want TPM-sealed keys we need firmware TPM 2.0 and secure boot ON. Example TPM check: `ls /dev/tpm0 || ls /dev/tpmrm0`

Claire (Security): A few policy notes: - BYOD must run our management agent (remotewipe + cert escrow). - If TPM is absent or disabled we require a stronger passphrase + agent key escrow to KMS. - Failure on PhishSim = automated coach + must pass remedial module; we do not auto-deprovision for a missed sim but repeated misses escalate.

Lena Park: Thanks. If I enable TPM in BIOS, will that break my current home LUKS setup? Also how are VPN client certs stored with no TPM?

IT-helpdesk: Enabling TPM typically won't break LUKS by itself, but if you're using TPM-unseal integration you should backup your header (`sudo cryptsetup luksHeaderBackup --header-backup-file header.img /dev/sda3`). For VPN certs: when TPM available we'll provision certs bound to TPM; without TPM we place certs in the agent vault which is wrapped by KMS.

Lena Park: Got it. Can we schedule a quick 15-min enroll walkthrough today? I'm in PST. Also where do I sign the BYOD agreement?

Mara (People Ops): I'll send a DocuSign BYOD MOU shortly. 15-min walkthrough: putting a tentative 4:30pm PT invite from IT-helpdesk. @onboarding-bot please nudge Lena about PhishSim window and update training deadline to end of week.

onboarding-bot: Assigned: "Security Onboarding: Essentials" due 2025-04-26. PhishSim window: 2025-04-23 to 2025-04-30. Reminders: 3x.

Claire (Security): TL;DR action items: sign MOU, enable secure boot/TPM if possible (backup LUKS header), paste `lsblk -f` + `ls /dev/tpm*` in thread before walkthrough, complete PhishSim within window. We'll annotate contractor flag if needed.

IT-helpdesk: Calendar invite sent (4:30pm PT). Attached pre-check script and link to a one-click LUKS header backup. See you then.

Lena Park: Thanks everyone  I pasted outputs (sanitized): `ls /dev/tpm*`: /dev/tpmrm0
`lsblk -f`:
NAME FSTYPE LABEL UUID
sda
sda1 vfat 1A2B-3C4D
sda2 ext4 5e6f7g8h-...
sda3 crypto_LUKS a1b2c3d4-...

Lena Park: Signed the MOU via DocuSign. Will attend the walkthrough. Appreciate the fast help! :pray:
